scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @mailflow/api && concurrently -k -n api,worker,frontend "npm run dev --workspace @mailflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @mailflow/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @mailflow/frontend"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @mailflow/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @mailflow/api && npm run dev --workspace @mailflow/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @mailflow/api && npm run build --workspace @mailflow/worker && npm run build --workspace @mailflow/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @mailflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @mailflow/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @mailflow/frontend
